info.name: DX Control Plane API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive API test suite for DX Control Plane and ACL APD.

Covers all 130+ endpoints with role-based authentication via Keycloak.

## Setup
1. Import the matching environment file (local-docker or deployed)
2. Run folder '00 – Auth & Token' first to populate tokens
3. Run folders sequentially — later folders depend on IDs created by earlier ones

## Roles
- **cosadmin**: COS Administrator (full platform access)
- **orgadmin**: Organisation Administrator
- **provider**: Data Provider (publishes assets)
- **consumer**: Data Consumer (accesses assets)
- **delegate**: Delegate (acts on behalf of others)
